   Sports Christian Justus Watson Week 10 Preview vs. the Vikings
 Nov 13, 2026 Photo : Billie Weiss / Getty Images Sport / Getty Images 
 Christian Justus Watson will be running routes against the second-best passing defense in the league when his Green Bay Packers meet the Minnesota Vikings in Week 10, on Sunday at 1 p.m. ET.
 Christian Watson's 49 grabs have yielded a team-best 879 total yards (and an average of 97.7 per game) and seven scores. He has been targeted 74 times.
 Listen to the game on 97.3 The Game 
 Watson vs. the Vikings
 Watson vs the Vikings (since 2021): 2 GP / 98 REC YPG / 2 REC TD
 Minnesota has allowed just one opposing receiver to amass 100 or more receiving yards in a game in the 2026 season.
 The Vikings have surrendered a TD pass to four opposing players this year.
 Minnesota has allowed only one player to record at least two TD catches against it in a matchup on the season.
 The 161.1 passing yards per game conceded by the Vikings defense makes them the NFL's second-ranked pass defense.
 The Vikings' defense is ranked first in the NFL with five passing TDs conceded so far this year.
 Catch NFL action all year long on Fubo. 
 Watson Receiving Insights
 In five of nine games this season, Watson has exceeded his prop for receiving yards.
 Watson has been targeted on 74 of his team's 341 passing attempts this season (21.7% target share).
 He has 879 receiving yards on 74 targets to rank fourth in NFL play with 11.9 yards per target.
 Christian Justus Watson has reeled in a TD pass in five of nine games this season, with more than one score in two of those games.
 He has scored seven of his team's 25 offensive touchdowns this season (28.0%).
 With seven red zone targets, Watson has been on the receiving end of 14.6% of his team's 48 red zone pass attempts.
